overhead_analysis.tradeoff_justification: ML-DSA-65 signatures are ~3.3 KB compared to 64 B for Ed25519. In HORA-Q, signatures are generated per-alert and per-evidence-vault entry rather than per raw packet wire-rate, making the 3.3 KB storage overhead easily negligible while providing unconditional post-quantum non-repudiation.

preliminary_benchmark_disclaimer: These metrics represent a controlled testbed comparison between the proposal's naïve baseline and Enhanced HORA-Q across a calibrated test stream. They confirm the functional differentiation predicted in the proposal (0.0% baseline contamination vs 66.7%, and strict candidate quarantine against single-peer flapping), rather than claiming universal Internet-wide accuracy statistics.
